title: An Axe Head Floats and Chariots of Fire

questions.question: What miracle did Elisha perform for the sons of the prophets at the Jordan?
options: He made an iron axe head float
questions.correctAnswer: He made an iron axe head float
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:6 (ESV): "...he cut off a stick and threw it in there and made the iron float."

questions.question: Why was the servant of Elisha afraid at Dothan?
options: The city was surrounded by the Syrian army
questions.correctAnswer: The city was surrounded by the Syrian army
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:15 (ESV): "...And behold, an army with horses and chariots was all around the city..."

questions.question: What did Elisha pray for his servant to see?
options: The mountain full of horses and chariots of fire
questions.correctAnswer: The mountain full of horses and chariots of fire
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:17 (ESV): "...and he saw, and behold, the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire all around Elisha."

questions.question: What did Elisha pray to happen to the Syrian army?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:18 (ESV): "...Strike this people, I pray, with blindness..."

questions.question: Where did Elisha lead the blinded Syrians?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:19 (ESV): "...But he led them to Samaria."

questions.question: What happened during the siege of Samaria caused by Ben-hadad?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:25 (ESV): "And there was a great famine in Samaria..."

questions.question: What horrifying thing did the king hear women had done?
options: Boiled and ate their own son
questions.correctAnswer: Boiled and ate their own son
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:28-29 (ESV): "...So we boiled my son and ate him..."

questions.question: How did the King of Israel react to the woman's story?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:30 (ESV): "When the king heard the words of the woman, he tore his clothes..."

questions.question: Who did the king blame for the famine?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:31 (ESV): "...if the head of Elisha the son of Shaphat remains on his shoulders today."

questions.question: Did the King of Israel kill the Syrian captives?
options: No, he fed them and sent them away
questions.correctAnswer: No, he fed them and sent them away
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:22-23 (ESV): "...Set bread and water before them... So he prepared for them a great feast... and he sent them away..."

questions.question: Why did the axe head fall into the water?
options: As one was felling a log
questions.correctAnswer: As one was felling a log
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:5 (ESV): "But as one was felling a log, his axe head fell into the water..."

questions.question: Why was the loss of the axe head significant?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:5 (ESV): "...Alas, my master! It was borrowed."

questions.question: How much did a donkey's head sell for during the famine?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:25 (ESV): "...until a donkey's head was sold for eighty shekels of silver..."

questions.question: Who was with Elisha when the messenger came?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:32 (ESV): "Elisha was sitting in his house, and the elders were sitting with him..."

questions.question: Where did the sons of the prophets want to go to build a dwelling?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 6:2 (ESV): "Let us go to the Jordan and each of us get there a log..."

key_verse_text: He said, “Do not be afraid, for those who are with us are more than those who are with them.” (ESV)
